Yesterday afternoon, I went to a circus for the first time. It was really exciting! I went with my mum, my grandpa and Jill. The tickets were a present from Grandpa.

The best thing at the circus was a clown called Charlie. Everyone laughed at him a lot. Everything he did was really funny. He had a white face, a big red nose and a tall, black hat. His clothes were all too big for him.

First, Charlie played with three balls. He tried to throw and catch them, but he always dropped one. Then he lost a ball, and he looked for it in funny places. He came and asked Jill, ‘Have you got it?’ She laughed and laughed, and said, ‘No!’ But then he took off his hat, and the ball was on his head! We were really surprised. When we got home, Jill dressed up in Dad’s clothes and painted her nose red. She wants to be a clown. I want to go to the circus again.
